answer: Someone running 113 aliases therefore needs 20 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. Locks are recorded in ember, expire in horizon, and gale lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 27 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 1866 identities would post 1571 proofs and burn roughly 65 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
